name: podrouzek/sitepackage-base
description: Reusable TYPO3 site package starter kit: TypoScript skeleton, Fluid layout/partials, Content Blocks, and b13/container grid presets. Brand-neutral — carries no hardcoded colors, fonts, or copy. Meant to be lifted into future projects unmodified; brand packages (e.g. sitepackage_promo) supply the CSS custom properties, logo, and site identity constants documented in README.md.
